verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services such as startup formation, venture financings, IP and employment advice. An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a software-developer capability outside this kind of product, so the question is a category error. Nothing in the pack shows the firm ships an API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so the exception does not apply.
